answer: Seed the economy with hidden one-shot trust games. Randomly pair keys and offer each a private split: cooperate and both earn a little, or defect and grab the pot. Strangers behave like a nebula of mixed, noisy choices, but keys run by one operator never really betray each other, so their pairings come back cooperative far above chance. Pairs whose mutual-generosity rate climbs to a suspicious summit get flagged violet on the audit board, and their payouts merge until a manual review clears them.
